powers.title: Archer's Stairway
powers.description: A stairway of arrows appears where you point your bow.
rows: Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or a crossbow.

Effect: Choose 5 contiguous squares of a vertical surface within your weapon range that you can see. The DC for climbing these squares is reduced by twice your Dexterity until the end of the encounter.

powers.title: Begin the Hunt
powers.description: You quickly identify your prey and ready yourself to attack it.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative

Effect: You gain a +2 bonus to the initiative check, and using your Hunter's Quarry, you designate one creature you can see as your quarry. You gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls against that creature until it is no longer your quarry.

powers.title: Bending Branch
powers.description: You resist a foe's attempt to move you, and like a great tree swaying in a storm, you snap back, ready to attack
rows: Trigger: You are pulled, pushed, or slid
Effect: You negate the forced movement. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to your next melee attack roll before the end of your next turn

powers.title: Bridge of Roots
powers.description: The primal energy you draw from the ground calls forth a churning mass of great roots that can cover even the most dangerous ground.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. At least one square of the zone must be on a solid surface. You and your allies can ignore hindering terrain and difficult terrain in the zone. In addition, any portion of a pit, chasm, or similar feature within the zone becomes safe, passable ground.
Move Action: You move the zone up to 5 squares, keeping at least one square on a solid surface.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 162.

powers.title: Crucial Advice
powers.description: You are wise in all things. The sooner your friends realize this, the safer and better off they'll be.
rows: Trigger: An ally within range that you can see or hear makes a skill check using a skill in which you're proficient
Effect: Grant the ally the ability to reroll the skill check, with a power bonus equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Entangling Roots
powers.description: Thick roots emerge from the ground in response to your command, and your foes stumble as they try to slip through them.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. The ground in the zone is difficult terrain for your enemies. When any enemy charges, its movement cannot include any square of the ground in the zone.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 162.

powers.title: Ferret an Opening
powers.description: With a keen eye, you use one moment of advantage to create another.
rows: Requirement: You must be flanking an enemy.
Effect: You gain combat advantage against the flanked enemy until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Fox Shift
powers.description: Distracted by your ally, your foe can't respond effectively to your sly maneuvering.
rows: Trigger: You hit a target with a melee attack and the target is marked by an ally
Effect: You can shift 1 square, and you gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses against your target's attacks until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Hunter's Privilege
powers.description: Your keen senses and uncanny instincts give you an edge over your quarry.
rows: Trigger: You make an initiative check at the beginning of an encounter and your check result is higher than any other combatant's
Effect: Until the stance ends, you add 3 to the extra damage you deal with Hunter's Quarry.

powers.title: Invigorating Stride
powers.description: You back away from danger and catch your breath.
rows: Effect: You shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom and must not end the shift adjacent to any enemy. You can use your second wind.

powers.title: Oak Skin
powers.description: Your skin takes on the texture of tough bark, protecting you from the worst of your enemies' attacks.
rows: Effect: You gain resistance to all damage until the end of the encounter. The resistance equals your Wisdom.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 187.

powers.title: Ranger's Agility
powers.description: The power of the primal spirits lets you move with the speed and subtlety of the wind.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a +2 power bonus to speed, and whenever you shift, the distance you can shift increases by 1 square.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 187.

powers.title: Safe Passage
powers.description: The spirits of earth, stone, and land accept your plea for assistance, allowing you and your allies to move unhindered and at great speed.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, each target ignores difficult terrain and gains a +2 power bonus to speed.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 187.

powers.title: Stalker's Mist
powers.description: A thick fog settles over the area, blocking sight and muffling sound. Though the fog confounds other creatures, you can see through it with ease.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. Squares in the zone are heavily obscured to your enemies.
Move Action: You move the zone up to 5 squares.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 162.

powers.title: Terrain Advantage
powers.description: You use the terrain around you as your first line of defense.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +4 power bonus to all defenses while you occupy a square of difficult terrain.

powers.title: Unbalancing Parry
powers.description: You deftly block your enemy's strike and turn his momentum against him, causing him to stumble to the side.
rows: Trigger: An enemy misses you with a melee attack
Effect: You slide the enemy three squares into a square adjacent to you and gain combat advantage against it until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Yield Ground
powers.description: Even as your foe connects, you leap backward, out of the way of further harm.
rows: Trigger: An enemy damages you with a melee attack
Effect: You can shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom. Gain a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Arrow of the Savior
powers.description: Your arrow saves a falling friend by pinning him or her to a nearby wall, or presenting a sudden handhold.
rows: Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or a crossbow.
Trigger: A creature in range falls and has a wall or floor within 1 square of it
Target: The triggering creature

Effect: The creature can attempt a saving throw to avoid falling farther. If successful, you can slide the creature 1 square to a horizontal surface, or to a vertical surface that the creature now climbs.

powers.title: Battle Runner
powers.description: You move with astonishing speed, making it hard for your foes to track your movement.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you can run a number of squares equal to your speed + 4, instead of your speed + 2, and you do not grant combat advantage from running.

powers.title: Boundless Energy
powers.description: You call upon your inner strength to persevere.
rows: Trigger: You roll an Endurance check and dislike the result
Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Endurance.
Effect: Reroll the Endurance check. You decide whether to make the reroll before the DM announces the result.

powers.title: Death Threat
powers.description: You bring down your quarry and then fix your hunter eyes on another foe
rows: Trigger: You reduce your quarry to 0 hit points
Effect: Choose one enemy within 5 squares of you. You designate that enemy as your quarry, and you gain combat advantage against it until the end of your next turn

powers.title: Evade Ambush
powers.description: You are the eyes and ears of the group, always alert for the telltale signs of an ambush.
rows: Effect: At the start of a surprise round in which any allies are surprised, use this power to allow a number of allies equal to your Wisdom to avoid being surprised.

powers.title: Healing Herbs
powers.description: You aid a wounded companion by quickly applying a poultice of healing herbs.
rows: Target: One ally

Effect: You make a Medicine check. The target regains hit points equal to half the result of your check. The target can make a saving throw against one poison effect on him or her that a save can end.

powers.title: Healing Lore
powers.description: The primal power you call upon allows access to the deepest reserves of strength.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst
Effect: The target can spend a healing surge.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 164.

powers.title: Off-Hand Defense
powers.description: You keep your off-hand weapon ready to block enemy attacks.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +1 power bonus to AC while you are conscious and wielding two melee weapons. If you do not make an off-hand attack during your turn, the bonus is instead +2 until the start of your next turn.

powers.title: Serpentine Dodge
powers.description: You snake past your enemies, weaving so that they have a hard time making a follow-up attack against you.
rows: Requirement: You must be within 2 squares of at least two enemies.

Effect: You can shift a number of squares equal to 1 + your Wisdom. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a power bonus to all defenses equal to the number of enemies you were adjacent to at any time during this shift.

powers.title: Skilled Companion
powers.description: Your allies benefit from the things that you have learned.
rows: Target: One ally

Effect: Choose a skill in which you are proficient but the target is not. Until the end of the encounter, the target gains a power bonus to checks with that skill equal to your Wisdom. The target must see or hear you to gain this bonus when making a check.

powers.title: Stealthy Escape
powers.description: You slip into the shadows, too smoothly for anyone to notice.
rows: Prerequisite: You must be proficient in Stealth.
Trigger: You make a Stealth check and dislike the result
Effect: Reroll the Stealth check with a bonus equal to your Wisdom. You can use the higher of the two rolls. If the second result is lower than the first, you do not expend this power.

powers.title: Step of Morning Mist
powers.description: A magical mist wraps around you, letting you cross the battlefield in the blink of an eye, then clinging to you as a protective shroud.
rows: Effect: You teleport up to 5 squares, then gain a +5 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 189.

powers.title: Thorn Ward
powers.description: A shimmering tangle of briars appears before you. It seems harmless, but as a foe moves through it, the briars lash out like a living creature.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. Any enemy that ends its turn in the zone takes damage equal to your Wisdom.
Move Action: You move the zone up to 5 squares.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 164.

powers.title: Weave Through the Fray
powers.description: You dodge through the thick of the fight, denying your foes a chance to pin you down in one spot.
rows: Trigger: An enemy moves adjacent to you
Effect: You can shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom.

powers.title: Agile Escape
powers.description: Nothing can slow you down.
rows: Trigger: You are hit by an attack that makes you slowed, immobilized, restrained, or dazed
Effect: You gain a +4 power bonus to all defenses against the triggering attack.

powers.title: Blood of the Fallen
powers.description: Your triumph is like a balm to you
rows: Trigger: You reduce your quarry to 0 hit points
Effect: You regain hit points equal to your healing surge value + your Strength

powers.title: Defensive Volley
powers.description: Your swift arrow weakens an enemy's attack.
rows: Requirement: You must be wielding a bow or a crossbow.
Trigger: An ally is hit by an attack
Target: The triggering ally
Effect: You reduce the damage the target takes by your Dexterity plus half your level.

powers.title: Expeditious Stride
powers.description: Like a gazelle, you startle allies and enemies alike with your sudden swiftness.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, your speed increases by 4, and when you shift, you can shift 1 additional square.

powers.title: Eyes of the Owl
powers.description: The spirits of the night grant you enhanced senses.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains both darkvision and a +2 power bonus to Perception checks until the end of the encounter.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 165.

powers.title: Hunter's Thorn Trap
powers.description: Your primal magic forms invisible thorns that lurk just below the surface of the ground. When a foe steps on their location, they erupt to rend and tear flesh.
rows: Target: One square

Effect: The target becomes a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter or until an enemy enters it. Without a Perception check (DC 10 + your level + your Wisdom), your enemies notice neither the zone nor your use of this power. When an enemy enters the zone, the enemy takes 5 + your Wisdom damage, and it is immobilized until the end of your next turn.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 166.

powers.title: Hunting Party
powers.description: You're not about to give up with a simple miss.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, each time you miss your quarry with an attack, you can choose an ally within 5 squares of the quarry. If that ally hits the quarry before the start of your next turn, the ally's attack deals extra damage equal to your Hunter's Quarry damage.

powers.title: Open the Range
powers.description: You keep your distance from an approaching adversary, backpedaling easily away from him.
rows: Trigger: An enemy moves adjacent to you
Effect: You can shift 1 square and then move a number of squares equal to 1 + your Wisdom. You can't end your move adjacent to the triggering enemy.

powers.title: Padfoot Advance
powers.description: You glide over the ground like a stalking cat.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your turn, you don't take a penalty to Stealth checks for moving, and if you don't hit with an attack while you are hidden, you remain hidden.

powers.title: Prime Shift
powers.description: Always in motion, you dart in for the shot before spinning away.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you can shift a number of squares equal to your Wisdom as a move action whenever you hit an enemy with a ranged attack that has the bonus from the Prime Shot class feature.

powers.title: Resume the Hunt
powers.description: You drop a foe and then sprint away in search of the next fight.
rows: Trigger: You reduce an enemy to 0 hit points
Effect: You move your speed. You don't provoke opportunity attacks for leaving a square at the start of this movement. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +2 bonus to all defenses.

powers.title: Root Gate
powers.description: At your command, great roots threaded with primal power burrow through the ground around you, closing the space between two points on the battlefield.
rows: Effect: You create two zones, each one in an unoccupied square in the burst. The zones last until the end of the encounter. When you or any of your allies enters either of the zones, that character can teleport to the other zone as a free action, as long as the destination zone is unoccupied.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 190.

powers.title: Shed the Mark
powers.description: Your enemies can't keep track of your fast movements.
rows: Requirement: You must be marked.
Effect: The marked condition ends, and you can shift 1 square.

powers.title: Undaunted Stride
powers.description: You expertly navigate through difficult terrain.
rows: Effect: Your movement is not hindered by difficult terrain.

powers.title: Verdant Flames
powers.description: Eldritch green flames wrap around your enemies, hampering their ability to defend themselves or hide from you.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the encounter. Enemies grant combat advantage and take a –5 penalty to Stealth checks while in the zone. Any enemy that ends its turn in the zone takes fire damage equal to your Wisdom.
Move Action: You move the zone up to 5 squares.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Forgotten Kingdoms, page(s) 166.

powers.title: Weathered Resilience
powers.description: Each setback, stumble, or wound bolsters your determination to succeed.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain resistance to all damage equal to your Wisdom while you are bloodied.
